description: Public OAuth client for Synthigy's own first-party tooling — the modeler, data console and log cockpit. Supersedes the former "Synthigy" and "Synthigy Components" clients, which were merged into this one: they pointed at the same API audience and differed only by origin, so two client registrations bought nothing but a second thing to keep in sync. Auth flow: redirect (or popup) to login, redirect back to the hosting page.
name: Synthigy Tools
